definitions: A compact metal-encapsulated switchgear that uses sulfur hexafluoride (SF6) gas or other insulating gases as the primary insulation.
Electrical equipment used for controlling, protecting, and isolating electrical circuits, where the live parts are enclosed in a gas-tight metal enclosure and insulated by a dielectric gas.
examples: The new substation will feature state-of-the-art gas-insulated switchgear.
Maintenance on gas-insulated switchgear is typically less frequent than air-insulated types.
